findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects, including the referenced customer-master.xlsx object, are not protected by bucket-enforced encryption at rest.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored financial data without bucket-enforced encryption at rest.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects can be stored without bucket-enforced encryption at rest.
The data science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Its contents are not protected by bucket-enforced encryption at rest.
